data.title: Precise Biometrics Extends IOTRUST Partnership for Next-Gen DCENT Crypto Wallets
data.description:
Precise Biometrics AB ( (SE:PREC) ) just unveiled an update.

Precise Biometrics, a Nasdaq Stockholm-listed biometrics specialist, is extending its partnership with South Korea’s IOTRUST to supply BioMatch fingerprint authentication for the next generation of DCENT biometric hardware crypto wallets. The move reinforces Precise’s role in securing digital identity across devices and channels, while supporting IOTRUST’s position as a leading provider of secure, user-friendly self-custody solutions for digital assets.

Under the renewed collaboration, Precise’s on-device fingerprint technology will power the second-generation DCENT biometric crypto wallet, which was launched earlier this month. As global adoption of digital assets accelerates, the partnership underscores growing demand for strong yet convenient authentication, strengthening both companies’ market positioning in secure digital asset management and offering enhanced security and usability to DCENT’s worldwide user base.

data.title: Mare Group Wins Golden Power Clearance for CTMAVIO Deal, Accelerating Aerospace Expansion
data.description:
Mare Engineering Group SpA ( (IT:MARE) ) has shared an update.

Mare Group S.p.A. has obtained Golden Power clearance from the Italian Presidency of the Council of Ministers for its acquisition of CTMAVIO S.r.l., removing a key regulatory condition tied to national defence and security considerations. As a result, the company now expects to close the €9 million transaction by the end of September 2026, ahead of the original mid-November deadline.

CTMAVIO operates five plants in Italy and designs and produces precision metal and composite components, equipment and structures for aeronautical, motor and unmanned systems, serving the Aeronautics, Space and Defence sectors. With CTMAVIO’s integration, Mare Group will add in-house production capacity for components and structures for engines, aircraft and drones to its aerospace and defence industrial platform, potentially reinforcing its vertical integration and competitive positioning in the European defence and aerospace supply chain.
